name: Magic Powers Tycoon
desc:
🪄 Unlock 14 types of Magic 🔥 Defeat other PLAYERS and BOSSES 🧙‍♂️ 

🏰 Build uniquely themed buildings for each Magic Type
💪 Grow stronger with each rebirth with permanent stat bonuses
✨ Unlock powerful exclusive rebirth spells
💥 Map-wide events like METEOR SHOWERS, 10x DAMAGE, KING OF THE HILL and more

💾 Each type of Magic has it's own save slot  💾

🎮 CONTROLS 🎮
[DASH] - Q on PC | LEFT TRIGGER on Controller | Tap the button on Mobile
[SHOOT] - Left Mouse Button on PC | RIGHT TRIGGER on Controller | Tap on Mobile
[MULTI-JUMP] - Press your default jump control mid-air 

⚠️ This game is solo developed. Join the socials to vote on which elements, spells and other content to add next! ⚠️
